_doc: DRAFTED presentation overlay — machine first draft from the build's own terminals, NOT an operator ruling. tier: default 67, 147 only where the terminal's own grounded text shows money at stake, a live deadline, or an adverse determination. Escapes are forced to tier 67 by the translator. Rule the tiers, then re-run emit-engine with --accept-overlay. Remove _drafted once ruled.
_doctrine: structural/critical → 147; explainer/guidance → 67. Every row's evidence is printed by the drafter.

none_fit.heading: This check may not cover your situation
none_fit.result_copy: Your answers do not match any of the situations this check is built to resolve. That does not mean nothing applies to you — it means this particular check is not the right instrument for the question you are asking, and forcing an answer here would give you a false read. If the subject is still relevant to you, a short personalised review establishes which rules actually govern your position.

insufficient_information.heading: Your answers do not settle this yet
insufficient_information.result_copy: At least one detail needed to reach a conclusion is still unconfirmed, so this check cannot tell you where you stand without guessing — and on a tax position a guess is worse than no answer. A short personalised review works through the missing detail and sets out where you actually stand.

_ruled.rule: explainer/happy-path 67; money/structural 147; the drafter's criticality and severity kept as drafted

per_state.fbt-how-calculated: STRUCTURAL + money: the taxable-value calculation itself — gross-up rates 2.0802 / 1.8868 and the 47% rate. The drafter already had it.
per_state.fbt-employer-obligations: STRUCTURAL + adverse: what the employer MUST do — register, report, pay, and the $3,000 quarterly-instalment threshold. The drafter already had it.
per_state.fbt-family-business-owner-perks: STRUCTURAL: this is the product's own subject — benefits treated as 'part of being an owner' being reclassified as employee fringe benefits, with FBT at 47% following. Adverse and money-bearing; the drafter had it at 67 as an explainer.
per_state.fbt-who-is-an-employee: STRUCTURAL: the employee/owner boundary IS the determination the reclassification risk turns on. Getting it wrong is what creates the liability, so it is not explanatory.
per_state.fbt-what-is-it: EXPLAINER by name and content — what FBT is and which benefits attract it.
per_state.fbt-exempt-benefits: HAPPY PATH: the exemptions and concessions — a favourable outcome, clearly stated.
